newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 28.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* Wall Street up 38 points to record 7383.
* On Tuesday, the benchmark Kuala Lumpur Composite Index was again overshadowed by smaller-caps, closing up a slight 0.69 to 1,081.88. The Second Board jumped 9.91 points or 1.75 percent to 576.08.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5145/55 a dollar at around 1000 GMT on Tuesday against opening of 2.5015.
* Dominance by small-cap, retail-focused stocks seen continuing, analysts said.
* "The main board is just languishing, trying to form a base or foundation," said Patrick Zecha, head of research at South Johor Securities.
* New Straits Times group reported six-month results on Tuesday. The newspaper publisher's half-year net rose to 68.19 million ringgit versus 46.84 million.
Malaysian Resources six-month net jumped to 65.61 million from 25.11 million.
* Property concern Keladi Maju Bhd set to list on exchange, with offer of 9.479 million shares at 2.80 a share.
